title: Winged Angel in Ruins
description: A barefoot man with a full beard and long dark hair stands amid ancient stone ruins. He possesses large, ornate blue wings with golden mechanical accents, a glowing halo with radiating light beams behind his head, and wears a long tan coat over dark clothing.
prompt: A bearded man with large intricate blue and gold mechanical wings stands in the center of destroyed classical ruins with broken columns and cracked stone floor. He wears a long tan coat and is barefoot, with a radiant glowing halo and light rays emanating from behind his head. Dramatic golden hour lighting, ethereal atmosphere, detailed digital painting style.
